newsitem.title: USA: Evans sees $4.0 mln proceeds from deal.
newsitem.headline: Evans sees $4.0 mln proceeds from deal.

text.p: Evans Inc, the fur and apparel retail chain, said Friday it expects net cash proceeds of about $4.0 million from the sale and leaseback of its flagship store and corporate office headquarters in Chicago.
The proceeds, after a $500,000 deposit to secure the lease obligations, will be used to retire outstanding long-term debt and for working capital purposes.
"This transaction will greatly improve our liquidity and financial flexibility for the long term," said Patrick Regan, president and chief executive of Evans.
The company said it had pursued the sale of the store and corporate office building on State Street in downtown Chicago for several years.

The leasback arrangement involves two lease agreements, the company said. The first is a 15-year lease for 61,775 square feet of retail space. The second is a 10-year office lease for 36,020 square feet of corporate office space.
